column7: BulkRenameSecrets, SuspendProjectSecretsWithOptions, ResumeProjectSecrets and ExtendExpiringSecrets re-checked each secret with EnforceSecretWritePermission, which the owner pass alone satisfies, while REST gates all four on project-scope secrets.write with no owner pass: a project viewer who owned the project's secrets could rename, suspend, resume or extend them all through a direct core call (the #4508 / known-03 pattern on the bulk ops). enforceSecretWriteGate per secret now skips an owner without secrets.write. Defence in depth: REST already refused. Red before (the viewer-owner acted on every secret), green after; the developer owner is the control.
